extracted.intended_audience: authors/creators submitting manuscripts or creative works to WME Books
extracted.subtask_description: Legal Submission Terms & Conditions that govern sending creative materials to WME Books, specifying rights, warranties, arbitration, and notice requirements. Applies to individuals or entities submitting manuscripts, proposals, or other creative works for consideration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreement to Submission Terms upon submission
rubrics_metrics.description: By submitting your materials or creative works (“Materials”) for consideration and review by WME Books (“WME”), you are acknowledging and agreeing to the following Submission Terms & Conditions and Arbitration provisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WME has an established policy of refusing to accept or evaluate creative works absent your agreement to these Submission Terms & Conditions. By submitting your Materials to WME, you have agreed to be bound by these Submission Terms & Conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: WME not required to review Materials
rubrics_metrics.description: WME is not required to review your Materials, nor is WME required to take actions to keep them confidential.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submission does not obligate WME to evaluate, respond, or treat Materials as confidential; submitters should not assume review or confidentiality.

rubrics_metrics.name: No claim for use of non-copyrighted or independently conceived content
rubrics_metrics.description: In the course of our business dealings, WME and WME clients may create, and may receive, content which is similar to certain elements of your Materials. For the avoidance of doubt, your permission is not required, nor will you be entitled to credit or compensation, for any use of content that is not legally protected by copyright or that was conceived independently of the Materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Similarity alone does not create rights unless the element is legally copyright-protected and not independently conceived; submitters should understand independent creation defenses and limits on credit/compensation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Warranty of sole ownership and authority to submit
rubrics_metrics.description: You are the sole owner and/or author of the Materials and you have the exclusive right and authority, without the consent of any other party, to submit them to WME.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submitters represent they have all necessary rights and consents (including from co-authors, employers, or third parties) to submit the Materials and to permit WME's consideration/use as described.

rubrics_metrics.name: Release for loss or damage to submitted copies
rubrics_metrics.description: You release WME from any and all liability for loss of, or damage to, the copies of the Materials submitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submitters bear risk of loss/damage to physical or electronic copies; WME disclaims liability for such loss/damage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definition and broad scope of 'WME' parties
rubrics_metrics.description: The words “WME” or “WME Books” refers to WME IMG, LLC, William Morris Endeavor Entertainment, LLC, IMG Worldwide, LLC, IMG Worldwide Holdings, LLC, and Endeavor Group Holdings, Inc. and each of their former, current and future subsidiaries, affiliates, divisions, parents, equity holders, predecessors, successors and assigns, and all of their current, former and future officers, shareholders, members, partners, principals, investors, owners, directors, trustees, joint venturers, insurers, attorneys, employees, and agents (in their official and individual capacities).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The definition is intentionally expansive to include many corporate affiliates and persons; claims or releases apply broadly to all listed entities and individuals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Joint and several binding for multiple submitters/entities
rubrics_metrics.description: If Materials are submitted by more than one person, or by an entity, the words “you” or “your” shall refer to all such persons or entities, and this release will be binding jointly and severally upon all such persons or entities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multiple submitters (e.g., co-authors) are jointly responsible for representations and releases; liability and waivers apply to each submitter collectively and individually.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entire agreement and reliance clause
rubrics_metrics.description: You have read and understand these Submission Terms & Conditions and acknowledge that they set forth the entire agreement between WME and you relating to the Materials, and that by submitting your Materials to WME, you are relying on the language in these Submission Terms & Conditions and not on any other representations or warranties, express or implied.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submitters cannot rely on any verbal or other side commitments; only the written terms govern. This clause precludes reliance on other promises outside these terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Severability of provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: If any provision of these Submission Terms & Conditions is held to be invalid, void or unenforceable for any reason, the balance will nevertheless remain in full force and effect in all respects.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a court/tribunal invalidates part of the agreement, the rest remains enforceable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreement to website Terms of Use, Privacy and Cookie Policies
rubrics_metrics.description: You acknowledge and agree to be bound by the Terms of Use, Privacy Policy and Cookie Policy of this website.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submission also binds the submitter to the site's other policies; check those documents for additional obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Choice of law for disputes (New York law)
rubrics_metrics.description: These Submission Terms & Conditions shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York without regard to its choice of law rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any dispute interpretation will apply New York substantive law.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mandatory arbitration of disputes
rubrics_metrics.description: Any dispute arising out of or in connection with the Materials or these Submission Terms & Conditions (including any dispute relating to the scope of these Arbitration provisions) will be resolved in final and binding arbitration before a single neutral arbitrator.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Disputes (including arbitration-scope challenges) must be arbitrated rather than litigated in court, subject to the arbitration provisions below.

rubrics_metrics.name: Arbitration forum, rules, and arbitrator qualifications
rubrics_metrics.description: The arbitration shall be initiated and conducted according to either the JAMS Streamlined (for claims under $250,000) or JAMS Comprehensive (for claims over $250,000) Arbitration Rules and Procedures then in effect at the New York office of JAMS or its successor. The arbitrator shall be a retired judge of a state or federal court and experienced and knowledgeable in the entertainment industry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Which JAMS track applies depends on claimed amount; arbitration will occur in New York under JAMS rules before an experienced retired judge in the entertainment field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Arbitrator substantive limitations and finality of award
rubrics_metrics.description: Except as otherwise stated herein, the arbitrator shall be bound by the substantive rules of law imposed by the law of the State of New York and the United States of America, and shall not have the jurisdiction to alter these Submission Terms & Conditions or to award punitive damages or injunctive relief. The award in any such arbitration shall be final and binding and may be confirmed by any court of competent jurisdiction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Arbitrator cannot change the contract terms or grant punitive/injunctive remedies; awards are final but can be confirmed by courts for enforcement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allocation of arbitration costs
rubrics_metrics.description: The costs and expenses of arbitration, including reasonable attorneys’ fees and the costs of expert witnesses, shall be borne by the losing party.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The party that loses the arbitration must pay costs and fees, which may include attorneys' fees and experts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limitation on remedies if WME used copyrighted portion
rubrics_metrics.description: If an arbitration determines that WME or WME clients have used any portion of the Materials which is legally protected by copyright, your award will be limited to a monetary amount up to the fair market value, as of the date of your submission, of the non-exclusive right to use the Materials for similar use. You will not be entitled to credit or additional compensation for use of the Materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even if copying of copyrighted elements is found, remedies are capped at fair market value for a non-exclusive license as of submission date; no credit or extra compensation is available.

rubrics_metrics.name: No injunctive relief or prevention of publication
rubrics_metrics.description: You acknowledge that the monetary award provided is an adequate remedy to redress any harm you may suffer as a result of alleged use of elements of the Materials that are protected by copyright, and that you are not entitled to seek or receive injunctive relief or otherwise interfere with or prevent publication or other exploitation of any work which may include such elements of the Materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submitters waive the right to seek injunctive relief to stop publication or exploitation; money is the exclusive remedy as described.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice requirement and strict 90-day deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: For any claim relating to the Materials or these Submission Terms & Conditions, give written notice by registered mail to WME, General Counsel, 11 Madison Avenue, 18th Floor, New York, NY 10010, within 90 days after you first acquire knowledge of such claim, or if sooner, within 90 days after you acquire knowledge of facts sufficient to put you on notice of such claim.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Claims must be asserted by registered mail to the specified address within 90 days of knowledge; the clock runs from actual knowledge or facts sufficient to put you on notice, whichever is sooner.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consequences of failing to give timely notice
rubrics_metrics.description: Your failure to give WME such written notice before the expiration of such period will constitute an irrevocable waiver, relinquishment, and release of any rights, remedies, or causes of action you may otherwise have with respect to such claim.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Missing the 90-day notice deadline permanently waives any claim related to the Materials or these terms; strict deadline with severe consequence.
